newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates end a bit weaker in calm trade.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates end a bit weaker in calm trade.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed at 22.75 percent, below Monday's close of 22.875 percent but above the opening rate of 22.50 percent, dealers said.
The bulk of deals were concluded at around the closing rate in routine trade, they said.
"Most deals were struck around 22.75 percent," Sandor Szatmari of Unicbank said.
Dealers did not see signs of an immediate change in overnight rates, although there were expectations of a repo rate cut in the near future.
"We are at the beginning of the reserve period, everybody has time (to fill reserves up). Expectations for a repo rate cut prevail," Szatmari said.
